sources.title: Suno API Character Limits 2026: 1000 Style, 5000 Lyrics
sources.notes: Per-model table with a stated method: v3.5/v4 style 200 and lyrics 3000; v4.5/v4.5+/v5/v5.5 style 1000 and lyrics 5000; API title 80. Says exceeding the limit returns a 400 before credits are charged.
sources.snippet: On the current Suno models (V4.5, V4.5+, V5, V5.5), custom lyrics cap at 5,000 characters and the style prompt caps at 1,000 characters.

sources.title: Suno AI Prompt Guide 2026: What Changed Since v5.5
sources.notes: Front-loading, the bracket myth (no BPM/key in brackets inside Style), app title 100 vs API 80, v5.5 launched 2026-03-26 as a personalisation layer over v5 (Voices, Custom Models, My Taste).
sources.snippet: Suno truncates silently past the limit with no warning, so front-load genre, vocal direction and BPM early in the Style field.

sources.title: Zizwar/Awesome-Suno
sources.notes: Community link list: prompt guides, meta-tag references, downloaders. Useful as a discovery surface, not as a specification.
sources.snippet: Curated list of Suno AI tools, prompts and guides.

sources.title: Manifest V3 — content scripts
sources.notes: Content scripts run in an isolated world; communicate via chrome.runtime.sendMessage. Source for the selector isolation and message-passing design.
sources.snippet: Content scripts live in an isolated world and cannot access variables defined by the host page.

sources.title: chrome.storage API reference
sources.notes: storage.local quota ~10 MB (unlimitedStorage raises it), async access, onChanged events, sync area ~100 KB total.
sources.snippet: chrome.storage.local: 10 MB quota; async; stores objects and arrays natively.

sources.title: Don't Waste Time Learning Suno's Tags — Use This System
sources.notes: Tag vocabulary has been stable since the March 2026 update. Lyrics allow ~5000 but ~3000 characters (40-60 lines) is the quality sweet spot; beyond that Suno rushes or drops sections.
sources.snippet: Roughly 3,000 characters — about 40 to 60 lines — is the real quality sweet spot.

sources.title: gcui-art/suno-api
sources.notes: Reverse-engineered wrapper around the Suno web app (cookie-based). Documents /api/custom_generate style flows. Recorded as a RISK, not a recommendation: fragile, ToS-uncertain, and out of scope for a local-first tool.
sources.snippet: Self-hosted wrapper exposing Suno's private API endpoints; requires the user's session cookie.

sources.title: Suno v5 Secrets: Crafting AI-Generated Songs
sources.notes: Simple mode is a single box with 500 characters; custom mode exposes Style 1000 / Lyrics 5000 plus instrumental toggle and audio upload.
sources.snippet: Simple Mode: one input box (500 characters). Custom Mode: Style (1,000 chars) and Lyrics (5,000 chars).

sources.title: The Local-First Playbook: Building a Privacy-Centric AI Music Companion
sources.notes: Architecture source: five pillars of local-first (client-side processing, robust storage, clear operational boundaries, responsible permissions, on-device AI), chrome.storage.local vs localStorage table, MV3 component model, phased roadmap, explicit warnings about reverse-engineered APIs and DOM patching fragility. Local summary kept in this repo so the claim stays checkable without the original PDF.
sources.snippet: chrome.storage.local: extension-specific, ~10 MB, async, native objects; localStorage: page-scoped, ~5 MB, strings only, sync.

sources.title: Updated my master prompting doc (r/SunoAI)
sources.notes: Community consensus, explicitly not specification: front-load the first 20-30 words, max 2 genre anchors, 3-4 instruments, 2 mood words, one variable per test. Comments correct it toward 4-7 strong descriptors.
sources.snippet: Front-load the most important tags — the first 20-30 words carry the most weight.

sources.title: The Suno API Reality: Unofficial Tools & Legal Risks
sources.notes: Unofficial APIs break without notice and carry legal uncertainty; commercial use of reverse-engineered access is precarious. Supports the decision to keep the companion local-first and API-free.
sources.snippet: Reverse-engineered access is fragile and legally uncertain; commercial use is precarious.

sources.title: Spankie0001/suno-super-friends
sources.notes: Prior art for a Suno browser extension: bulk operations and library features. Cited for feature parity and for the permission-review discussion around extensions that ask for too much.
sources.snippet: Chrome/Edge extension for Suno with bulk tools and library management.

sources.title: obra/superpowers — agentic skills framework
sources.notes: SKILL.md format and process skills adopted here: using-superpowers (invoke before any action), brainstorming, writing-plans, subagent-driven-development, dispatching-parallel-agents, verification-before-completion, writing-skills (TDD for docs), systematic-debugging.
sources.snippet: If you think there is even a 1% chance a skill might apply to what you are doing, you ABSOLUTELY MUST invoke the skill.

sources.title: A Repeatable Suno Prompt Testing Plan for Creators
sources.notes: One-variable-at-a-time testing: hypothesis, single change, evidence, decision (keep / revert / narrow). Source for the experiment log design.
sources.snippet: Define a single variable question, keep every other prompt element constant, record the change, the evidence and the decision.

sources.title: 16 Free Suno Tools: Prompts, Lyrics, Downloads & MV
sources.notes: Tool inventory for feature parity: prompt builder (five pillars, lock/re-roll), style cleaner, tag normaliser, duration estimator, lyric diff, exclude builder, batch/profile downloaders, lyrics MV. States prompt and lyrics tools process text locally in the tab; link tools send the URL over the network.
sources.snippet: 16 free browser helpers. Prompt Builder composes a Style string from genre, instrumentation and texture, mood, vocal delivery and production notes.

sources.title: WXT — next-gen web extension framework
sources.notes: File-based entrypoints (background/content/popup/options), defineBackground/defineContentScript, manifest generation from config. Entrypoint side-effect rule enforced by the build: chrome APIs and instance construction must happen inside main().
sources.snippet: Cannot use imported variable outside the main function — entrypoint side effects are rejected at build time.
